# All templates

<!-- generated by scripts/build_pages.py from data/workflows.yml: do not edit by hand -->

Free Word and Excel templates. Each workbook has an About sheet with
instructions and a made-up example in grey italics. Green cells calculate
themselves.

| Template | Format | What it is | Used in |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Base-year recalculation policy](downloads/recalculation-policy.docx) | Word | One-page policy stating the base year, which changes trigger a recalculation, the significance threshold you disclose, and how changes are added up. | [S8](scope3/s8-base-year.md) |
| [CBAM declaration preparation checklist](downloads/cbam-declaration-checklist.docx) | Word | Step-by-step checks before submitting the annual CBAM declaration and surrendering certificates by 30 September. | [CB6](cbam/cb6-verification.md), [CB9](cbam/cb9-declaration.md) |
| [CBAM embedded emissions workbook](downloads/cbam-emissions-workbook.xlsx) | Excel | Embedded emissions per CN code from actual installation data (direct, indirect, precursors) or default values with the yearly mark-up, and the certificates and cost that follow. | [CB4](cbam/cb4-embedded-emissions.md), [CB5](cbam/cb5-precursors.md), [CB8](cbam/cb8-certificates.md) |
| [CBAM goods register](downloads/cbam-goods-register.xlsx) | Excel | One row per import line of CBAM goods, with a running total of net mass against the 50-tonne threshold that calculates itself. | [CB1](cbam/cb1-scope-check.md) |
| [CBAM supplier data request](downloads/cbam-supplier-request.docx) | Word | Cover letter asking an installation operator outside the EU for verified embedded emissions data, pointing to the Commission's official operator template. | [CB3](cbam/cb3-supplier-data.md) |
| [Double materiality assessment workbook](downloads/dma-workbook.xlsx) | Excel | Score impacts, risks and opportunities on a 1 to 5 scale, from the impact side and the financial side, and roll them up to the ten topical standards. | [C2](csrd/c2-dma.md) |
| [ESRS datapoint gap list](downloads/esrs-gap-list.xlsx) | Excel | The handbook's key ESRS datapoints, generated from its datapoint list, with whether each is in scope for you, its status (Ready, Partial, Gap or Phase-in), an owner and a date, and a summary. | [C7](csrd/c7-gap-analysis.md) |
| [IRO register](downloads/iro-register.xlsx) | Excel | A register of impacts, risks and opportunities (IROs) with where they arise in the value chain, the time horizon, the materiality result, the owner, the actions and the ESRS datapoints they feed. | [C2](csrd/c2-dma.md) |
| [Questionnaire response bank](downloads/questionnaire-response-bank.docx) | Word | Your standard answers to the ESG questions customers and banks ask most, each linked to a VSME datapoint and a source, with reply wording to adapt. | [V5](vsme/v5-requests.md) |
| [Scope 3 inventory workbook](downloads/scope3-inventory.xlsx) | Excel | A Scope 3 inventory line by line, with spend-based, average-data and supplier-specific tabs, a data-quality score and a 95% uncertainty on every line, and a summary by category. | [S4](scope3/s4-methods.md), [S6](scope3/s6-data-quality.md), [S9](scope3/s9-reporting.md) |
| [Scope 3 screening matrix](downloads/scope3-screening-matrix.xlsx) | Excel | Screen all 15 Scope 3 categories with a rough estimate each, test them against a size threshold you choose and other criteria, and record the reason for every decision. | [S2](scope3/s2-screening.md) |
| [Supplier emissions data request](downloads/supplier-letter.docx) | Word | Short letter asking a supplier for its emissions, total output and boundary for one year, so you can allocate your share for Scope 3. | [S7](scope3/s7-suppliers.md) |
| [VSME Basic Module workbook](downloads/vsme-basic-workbook.xlsx) | Excel | One row per Basic Module datapoint of the voluntary standard, with the value, its source, an owner and a status, and completeness tracked overall and by disclosure. | [V2](vsme/v2-basic.md) |

Browser tools are listed on [All tools](tools/index.md).
